facts.business: Cura Technologies Limited is an Indian listed company that underwent a Scheme of Amalgamation approved by NCLT Hyderabad Bench in 2023, with legacy balances under reconciliation; specific business operations are not described in the provided excerpts.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: except for the possible effects of the matter described in the Basis for Opinion paragraph

key_risks: Legacy balances comprising borrowings, other current liabilities, statutory dues, tax receivables and related balances taken over pursuant to amalgamation are under reconciliation and confirmation
Accounting software does not have audit trail (edit log) facility, not operated throughout the year, not preserved per statutory requirements
Certain charge satisfaction filings pertaining to amalgamating company not completed due to non-availability of complete and correct information
Title deeds of properties in process of being transferred to company name pursuant to Scheme of Amalgamation
